english.title: Bring firearm / offensive weapon on to dock estate without permission (Port of Liverpool)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) brought on to the dock estate

(A)_[a rifle, gun or pistol,]_
(B)_[an offensive weapon,]_

namely **(..DESCRIBE FIREARM OR WEAPON..), without the written permission of the Mersey Docks and Harbour Company Limited
